title: Zelensky Shrugs Off Trump-Putin Call, Skeptical of Ceasefire Prospects
detail: Ukrainian President Zelensky responded with apparent indifference to a Trump-Putin phone call, signaling deep skepticism that US-Russia bilateral dialogue will yield meaningful ceasefire progress. Kyiv has long insisted that any peace negotiations must include Ukraine as a direct party, and the exclusion of Zelensky from the Trump-Putin conversation reinforces Ukrainian concerns that Washington may cut a deal with Moscow over Kyiv's head. The call is the latest in a series of direct US-Russia contacts that Ukraine has watched warily as the war grinds into its fifth year.

media.caption: Zelensky responds with indifference to Trump-Putin call on Ukraine peace talks

title: Russian Drone Strikes Kill 1, Injure 6 in Kherson; Medical Vaccination Bus Destroyed Near Dnipro
detail: Russian forces conducted drone strikes on Kherson and surrounding areas throughout April 30, 2026, killing 1 person and injuring 6 others. Kherson has remained under persistent Russian drone and artillery attack since Ukrainian forces liberated the right-bank city in November 2022, with Russian forces continuing to occupy the opposite bank of the Dnipro River. Separately, a Ukrainian Ministry of Health vaccination bus was destroyed in a Russian drone strike in the suburbs of Dnipro — a deliberate attack on humanitarian infrastructure. Russian drones also struck Mykolaiv. Nikopol was under heavy fire. The attacks occurred on the same day as Trump's 90-minute phone call with Putin, during which the two discussed a possible short Victory Day ceasefire — a proposal Ukraine rejected, calling instead for a comprehensive long-term ceasefire. Ukrainian air defenses engaged incoming drones but Russian strikes penetrated coverage across multiple cities in southern Ukraine.

media.caption: Russian drone strikes kill 1 and injure 6 in Kherson; vaccination bus destroyed near Dnipro on April 30, 2026
